w2w2_waypoint_save_coalesce.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation of the ModSettings.saveWaypoints call in each XaeronCompatibility.addWaypoint overload: the save is remembered (one per waypoint world, first-remembered order) and run at the end of the client tick and before logout / client level unload (HIGHEST listeners registered on first use); off the client thread, or without listeners, the save runs at once. Trade-off (off by default): the waypoint file is written once per client tick instead of at every waystone update. Runtime flag w2w2WaypointSaveCoalesce. Helper bons.furious.patch.w2w2_coo49.W2w2Saves.
